source_clause: 2.2 / equation (2.1) (LIWL loading, ballast freezing prevention, propeller submergence and forward draught)

r13_contract.comparisonModel: When navigating in ice, draught_amidships_m >= LIWL_draught_amidships_m. Any ballast tank above LIWL that is needed to reach LIWL shall have freezing_prevention_present = true. propeller_highest_point_submerged = true. forward_draught_m >= min((2 + 0.00025*displacement_UIWL_t)*level_ice_thickness_m, 4*level_ice_thickness_m). If multiple UIWL waterlines exist, use the displacement at the greatest-displacement UIWL.

test_cases.rationale: Forward draught satisfies the uncapped formula branch for a 5000 t displacement.
Forward draught satisfies the 4hi cap branch for a 10000 t displacement.
Ballast tank above LIWL but not needed to reach LIWL does not require freezing prevention.
Non-ice-navigation case is outside the conditional loading obligations.
Forward draught is below formula 2.1 requirement.
Draught amidships is below LIWL amidships.
Highest point of propeller is not submerged.
Required ballast tank above LIWL lacks freezing prevention.
UIWL displacement needed by formula 2.1 is missing.
Level ice thickness uses the wrong unit.

benchmark_policy: Source/R13-defined behavioral oracle created without inspecting generated SHACL.
